decisions.reason: A large bulk container is a core industrial packaging product for a large plastics manufacturer, and having its own web page signals a committed, long-term part of the portfolio.
The valve complements the bulk container line, supports system sales and spare-part revenue, and was also given its own page.
A take-back service supports circular-economy and EU packaging regulation requirements and customer sustainability demands, so it is likely kept despite only being mentioned on the website.
